ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: 4/3/1/144. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/Servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired: The following allotment of land situated in the Grama Niladari Division of 725 Kalutara South in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kalutara in the District of Kalutara in Western Province and marked in Surveyor General’s Plan No. P.P.K. 4605 and contains in extent 0.6840 Hectares. 1. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land:Modarawella alias Kalapugoda watta; Description: Garden, about 30-40 Old Mixed Plantation and 4 Permanent Buildings, 2 parts of Permanent Buildings, Buddhist room and part of a Toilet; Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 0.6840 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Kalutara on the 05th day of October 2016 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21st day of September 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims

for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. You should present Relevant Deeds, Plans and other documents to prove ownership to the land on the inquiry date. BUDDHIKA RUWANI SAMARATUNGE, Divisional Secretary, Kalutara. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Kalutara, 29th August, 2016. 09 - 638 —————————— AMENDMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
Reference No. of the Divisional Secretary: 3/3/2/54. No. of the Ministry of Land Development: LD/05/2009/PC/92.

I, hereby give notice, that the date and time published for the inquiry in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 1844/46 and 06th January 2014 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka dated 19th March 2014 should be amended as 09.00 a.m. on 12th October 2016.
G. S. K. KANNANGARA, Divisional Secretary, Homagama.
